title: Mixed Event — Bustling Cafe ●REC! — Episode3 Parfait Perfection!

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP!'s latest gig is a TV segment on location at a popular cafe! Little do they realize, it's none other than the cafe where Minori works!

rows.Line: One hour later
carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Rolling in...!
Four, three...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! Ready to catch another...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Big wave?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Cowabunga!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's see what's hot right now!
It's trend surfing time!!!

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: Hey, what do you think they're doing at that booth over there? It's all covered in curtains!

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: Oh, when we came in, one of the waiters said that they're gonna be doing a shoot for TV or something here today.

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
That means some celebrities are here, right?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
I get to see a TV shoot take place literally right in front of me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
And everyone in MMJ's sooo cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is the show that airs late at night on Wednesdays, right?! I sort of have this attachment to it since I watch it all the time while I'm working on stuff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
I didn't know it aired so late at night!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it's been gaining a lot of traction lately!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And as fun as it is to see them shoot an episode, I can't wait to see it on TV♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now then!
Today, we're visiting a cafe called “carino/carina” located on Main Street in Shibuya!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Lately, their new Mount Everest strawberry parfait has been going totally viral on social media.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I saw some pictures and couldn't believe what I saw. It really is a mountain of strawberries and whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we get to try it today, right?!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Yes!
Not only does it look spectacular, it also tastes wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: So, bon appetit!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
O-Oh my...
It's much bigger than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And all these strawberries...
This has to be a month's worth... No, several months worth all in one place.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't forget the whipped cream...
I'm really glad we decided to split it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I doubt one person could ever eat all this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: At the same time, I get why everyone wants to post their pictures on social media. It looks adorable!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We're off to a good start.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Minori in particular is doing a good job of acting like it's her first time here. I was worried at first that her reactions wouldn't feel natural...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(But she's on a roll...!
So, let's keep this fun going!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's start digging in!
Also, we should have the camera do a close-up of the first person to take a bite.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But who...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Eeny, meeny, miney...♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looks like Airi's choosing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Just go with the flow!
Anyway...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
Show us what you got!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm very much looking forward to seeing how it tastes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I worried that it'd be too sweet because of all this whipped cream...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But the strawberries' tartness balances it all out! It's a wonderful combination!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you for noticing that!
We try to make the whipped cream not too sweet since that can become heavy and tiresome after a while...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: As for the strawberries, we tried many kinds until we found a cultivar that helps create the balance you just mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, so quite a lot of work went into this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No fair, Shizuku!
I wanna try it too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, since Shizuku just gave us a good shot of her enjoying this, let's join her!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, yes!
Then, I'm also gonna start digging in!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How do the strawberries taste?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Th-They're really good!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's really nice mix of sweet and sourness. I could eat a whole pile of these. How's the custard...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... It's delicious!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This isn't just a matter of replacing words with others that mean the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But this really is good.
Like Shizuku said, it's very nicely balanced.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I like how the top and bottom halves leave different impressions in terms of taste. The part with the cornflakes and custard is nice and refreshing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Despite how big it is, I can't seem to put down my spoon.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you very much.
I'm glad you're all enjoying it so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have a bit of a sweet tooth, but I don't see myself getting tired of this parfait anytime soon...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That being said, I'll have to exercise quite a lot starting tomorrow if I'm going to work this all off.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh nooo!
That's way too cute, Haruka! My brain's gonna overload if you keep saying stuff like that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm not sure what Haruka means by “exercise quite a lot”, but I get the feeling that she has a pretty grueling workout schedule in mind...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Have you had some yet, Airi? There might not be anything left for you if you don't hurry.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, you should try some.
It really is delicious.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, stop moving your spoon towards your mouth!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They're probably gonna finish this whole thing themselves at this rate.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think this calls for a Happy Snacker. It's been far too long.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy Snacker?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
W-W-W-W-We get to see you do a Happy Snacker?! Right here...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hold up...
What's a Happy Snacker?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's one of Happy Everyday's skills!
Whenever she eats something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, without further ado.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mmm. This is so yummy♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is one of her 1,000% Happy Idol Mode skills! She always looks so cute whenever she eats anything!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, you can sorta tell she's doing it on purpose, but I can see how this would make someone's heart flutter...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Airi!
It's been so long since I'd last seen you do a Happy Snacker!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, same!
It's been so long that I'm so moved!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, this was originally meant for when I had to eat or drink really strange stuff like natto juice or wheatgrass stew for variety shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But this is beyond delicious!
I'm a Happy Snacker in every sense!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so glad I was scheduled to do this shift. I'm never gonna forget what I just saw for as long as I live...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me neither! I really gotta thank Airi again for inviting me to work here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And it's not as busy as I was expecting it to be. I'm starting to feel bad about being paid for this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I get what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We do have a group coming in later, but it's pretty calm today. We should be able to handle everything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, more customers!
Hello! Welcome to... Huh?

Excuse me!
We have a reservation for a group of eight under the name “Fujin”!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wh-What?! A group as in a group of...?!
